scientific_integrity: Elementary full proof with a separate exhaustive finite-range cross-check; no assertion that finite tests certify the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: The classification requires at least three distinct run labels, one consecutive run per label, and n at least the primitive period; no claim about smaller lengths, arbitrary periodic colorings, or two-letter cycles. Novelty remains subject to unindexed equivalents; independently unvalidated.
title: Complete coordinate symmetry groups of cyclic words with three or more monochromatic runs
